I could not identify the change that fixed O3-5958. Falkon's indexed content has no reference to the ticket key, and I have no tool to read commit or PR history. What I can show is how the current code resolves the default and why a blank field can happen.

**How the ancestor default is resolved**

- `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/hooks/useSessionLocationAncestry.ts:9-37` builds the login location's `partOf` chain from FHIR, ordered from the location up to the root.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/patient-queue-header/queue-location-header-title.component.tsx:35-41` picks the first queue-tagged entry in that chain. The comment reads "the login location if queue-tagged, else its nearest queue-tagged ancestor, else 'All'".
- The same file, lines 43-68, writes that result into the store and session storage once per login location. The store write is `updateSelectedQueueLocationUuid` at line 56.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/store/store.ts:45-48` persists `queueLocationUuid` to session storage and to the store.

**How the new queue entry form reads it**

- `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/create-queue-entry/queue-fields/queue-fields.component.tsx:80-81` sets the initial `queueLocation` to `selectedQueueLocationUuid ?? sessionLocation?.uuid ?? ''`. This is read once, as `useForm` defaults.
- The `Select` at lines 213-236 only offers options from `useQueueLocations`, so a default that is not queue-tagged renders blank.
- Nothing in that component re-syncs `queueLocation` when the store changes after mount. That is consistent with the reported symptom, but I have not run it, so treat it as a reading of the code.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/create-queue-entry/hooks/useQueueLocations.ts:4-14` fetches `Location?_tag=queue location`, which is the option list.

**Tests covering this behaviour**

- `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/patient-queue-header/queue-location-header-title.test.tsx:71-79` covers the "falls back to the nearest queue-tagged ancestor" case.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/create-queue-entry/queue-fields/queue-fields.test.tsx:225-240` covers prefill from the store and the session-location fallback.

**Limits**

- I could not find which commit, PR, or ticket added the ancestor fallback, so I have not cited one. Checking `git log -S "resolvedDefault"` or the PR that introduced `useSessionLocationAncestry` in `openmrs-esm-patient-management` would settle it.
- The repository is indexed as `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-management`, not the bare name. I used the full name for all calls.
